rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for confidence as firm trust or certainty about a person, ability, or outcome.

example.english: I have a lot of confidence that I will pass this exam.
example.traditional: 我好有信心今次考試會合格。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 wui5 hap6 gaak3

rows.note: Use this specifically for personal self-assurance rather than confidence that an event or claim is true.

example.english: They have a lot of confidence when speaking on stage.
example.jyutping: keoi5 soeng5 toi4 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 zi6 seon3
